#summary This wiki explains how to install Windows development tools for GIMX.

<font color="red">Warning: this wiki is not finished! There remains an issue with the libxml.</font>

= Introduction =

This wiki explains how to install a compilation environment (based on MinGW) and Eclipse CDT (with SVN).
It also explains how to perform a checkout and build the project.

Target OS is Windows, but it can be easily adapted to Linux.
Unless otherwise specified, perform a default installation (default directories, etc).

= Note =

To speed up the compilation (make), specify how many processes the CPU can run at the same time.

Change the CPU variable of the install.sh script.

If the CPU can run 4 processes at the same time:
{{{
CPU=4
}}}

= Compiler & librairies =

=== MinGW installation ===

Download and run the latest <a href="http://sourceforge.net/projects/mingw/files/Automated%20MinGW%20Installer/mingw-get-inst">mingw-get-inst</a> version (as of this writing, 20110802).
The only thing to configure during the installation process: in the "Select Components panel, select "C++ Compiler" and "MSYS Basic System".
Add ";C:\MinGW\bin;C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\bin" (without quotes) to your system PATH.

=== Build ===

Run C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\msys.bat

Install wget:

{{{
mingw-get install msys-wget
}}}

Download and run the build script:

{{{
wget http://diyps3controller.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/win/install.sh
./install.sh
}}}

The installation folder is GIMX/setup.

= Eclipse =

Be sure to have a <a href="http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/java/javase/downloads/index.html">java JRE</a> installed on your system.

Download <a href="http://www.eclipse.org/downloads/">Eclipse IDE for C/C++ Developers</a>. Unzip it to wherever you want.

Run eclipse.exe.

=== SVN Plugin ===

Help>Install New Software

Work with: select your eclipse release name (as of this writing, Indigo).

type filter text: svn

Select "Subversive SVN Integration for the Mylyn Project" and "Subversive SVN Team Provider".

Proceed to installation (select latest SVN Kit - as of this writing, 1.3.5), and restart eclipse.

=== Project checkout ===

Project Explorer view, right click, New>Other.

Select SVN>Project from SVN, click next.

Enter URL: https://diyps3controller.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/sixaxis-emu

Click next, Click no (do not nomalize URL), and click "Trust Always" (googlecode certificate).

Click Head Revision, and click Finish.

Check out as: Select "Check out as a project configured using the New Project Wizard", select "Head Revision", and click finish.

Select a wizard: Select "C project" and click next.

Enter a Project name, and select "Makefile Project > Empty Project", and click next.

Click Finish.

Check out is performed, and the new project appears in the Project Explorer view.

The project is build automatically.
